senses: Καῦδα (TR, mg., Κλαῦδα; Rec. Κλαύδή), ἡ, Cauda, Clauda, an island near Crete: [[r:ACT.27.16|Act 27:16.]]† (AS)

G2804.strongs: Claudius, the name of two Romans

κλάω to break, break in pieces: of bread, [[r:MAT.14.19|Mat 14:19 15:36 26:26]], [[r:MRK.8.6|Mrk 8:6 14:22]], [[r:LUK.22.19|Luk 22:19 24:30]], [[r:ACT.2.46|Act 2:46 20:7, 11 27:35]], [[r:1CO.10.16|1Co 10:16 11:24]]; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.8.19|Mrk 8:19]] (cf. ἐκ-, κατα-κλάω).† (AS)

G2807.forms: κλείς, -δός Att.. accusative, κλεῖν, later -εῖδα, pl., κλεῖδες, -ας, contr., -εῖς, ἡ
G2807.strongs: a key (as shutting a lock), literally or figuratively

κλείω to shut: θύραν, [[r:MAT.6.6|Mat 6:6]]; τ. ἄβυσσον, [[r:REV.20.3|Rev 20:3]]; pass., θύρα, [[r:MAT.25.10|Mat 25:10]], [[r:LUK.11.7|Luk 11:7]] (pl.), [[r:JHN.20.19|Jhn 20:19, 26]], [[r:ACT.21.30|Act 21:30]]; δεσμωτήριον, [[r:ACT.5.23|Act 5:23]]; πυλῶνες, [[r:REV.21.25|Rev 21:25.]] Metaphorical, τ. οὐρανόν, [[r:LUK.4.25|Luk 4:25]], [[r:ROM.11.6|Rom 11:6]]; τ. σπλάγχνα, [[r:1JN.3.17|1Jn 3:17]]; τ. βασιλείαν, [[r:MAT.23.14|Mat 23:14]]; id. absol., [[r:REV.3.7|Rev 3:7]]; τ. θύραν, [[r:REV.3.8|Rev 3:8.]] (cf. ἀπο-, ἐκ-, κατα-, συν-κλείω.) † (AS)

G2809.strongs: stealing (properly, the thing stolen, but used of the act)

G2810.root: probably contracted from Κλεόπατρος (compound of [[w:G2811]] and [[w:G3962]])

senses: a thief: [[r:MAT.6.19|Mat 6:19-20 24:43]], [[r:LUK.12.33|Luk 12:33, 39]], [[r:JHN.10.1|Jhn 10:1, 10 12:6]], [[r:1CO.6.10|1Co 6:10]], [[r:1PE.4.15|1Pe 4:15]]. Fig., ὡς κ. ἐν νυκτί, [[r:1TH.5.2|1Th 5:2 5:4]] (κλέπτας, WH, txt., R, mg.; see Lft., Notes, 73; but cf. also M, Th., l.with), [[r:2PE.3.10|2Pe 3:10]], [[r:REV.3.3|Rev 3:3 16:15]]. Metaphorical, of false teachers, [[r:JHN.10.8|Jhn 10:8.]]† SYN.: λῃστής, a robber, a brigand who plunders, openly, with violence; κ. is a thief who steals in secret, by fraud and cunning (Tr., Syn., § xliv) (AS)

G2814.strongs: a limb or shoot (as if broken off)

G2816.strongs: to be an heir to (literally or figuratively)
senses: to inherit (in cl., usually with genitive of thing(s)): absol., [[r:GAL.4.30|Gal 4:30]] (LXX); in general, to possess oneself of, receive as one's own, obtain (as [[r:DEU.4.5|Deu 4:5]], al., cf. [[r:PSA.25.3|Psa 25:3]], [[r:ISA.61.7|Isa 61:7]]): with accusative of thing(s) (as generally in late Gk., see M, Pr., 65), of the Messianic Kingdom (cf. [[r:PSA.37.11|Psa 37:11]], [[r:SIR.4.13|Sir 4:13 37:26]], and see Dalman, Words, 125 ff.) and its bless­ings and privileges, τ. γῆν, [[r:MAT.5.5|Mat 5:5]] (cf. LXX); τ. βασιλείαν, β. θεοῦ, [[r:MAT.25.34|Mat 25:34]], [[r:1CO.6.9|1Co 6:9-10 15:50]], [[r:GAL.5.21|Gal 5:21]]; ζωὴν αἰώνιον, [[r:MAT.19.29|Mat 19:29]], [[r:MRK.10.17|Mrk 10:17]], [[r:LUK.10.25|Luk 10:25 18:18]]; σωτηρίαν, [[r:HEB.1.14|Heb 1:14]]; τ. ἐπαγγελίας, [[r:HEB.6.12|Heb 6:12]]; ἀφθαρσίαν, [[r:1CO.15.50|1Co 15:50]]; ὄνομα, [[r:HEB.1.4|Heb 1:4]]; τ. εὐλογίαν, [[r:HEB.12.17|Heb 12:17]], [[r:1PE.3.9|1Pe 3:9]]; ταῦτα, [[r:REV.21.7|Rev 21:7]] (cf. κατα-κληρονομέω).† (AS)

G2817.strongs: heirship, i.e. (concretely) a patrimony or (genitive case) a possession
senses: (κληρονόμος) prop., an inherited property, an inheritance: [[r:MAT.21.38|Mat 21:38]], [[r:MRK.12.7|Mrk 12:7]], [[r:LUK.12.13|Luk 12:13 20:14]]; in general, a possession, inheritance: [[r:ACT.7.5|Act 7:5]], [[r:HEB.11.8|Heb 11:8]]; of the Messianic Kingdom and its blessings, [[r:ACT.20.32|Act 20:32]], [[r:GAL.3.18|Gal 3:18]], [[r:COL.3.24|Col 3:24]], [[r:EPH.1.14|Eph 1:14, 18 5:5]], [[r:HEB.9.15|Heb 9:15]], [[r:1PE.1.4|1Pe 1:4]].† (AS)

G2818.root: from [[w:G2819]] and the base of [[w:G3551]] (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. (reflexively) getting by apportionment)
G2818.strongs: a sharer by lot, i.e. inheritor (literally or figuratively); by implication, a possessor
senses: (as in cl.) an heir: [[r:MAT.21.38|Mat 21:38]], [[r:MRK.12.7|Mrk 12:7]], [[r:LUK.20.14|Luk 20:14]], [[r:GAL.4.1|Gal 4:1]]; of those who as sons of God inherit the privileges of the Messianic Kingdom; of Christ himself, [[r:HEB.1.2|Heb 1:2]]; of Abraham, [[r:ROM.4.13|Rom 4:13-14]]; of Christians, [[r:ROM.8.17|Rom 8:17]], [[r:GAL.3.29|Gal 3:29]], [[r:TIT.3.7|Tit 3:7]], [[r:JAS.2.5|Jas 2:5]].
(As in LXX: Jg, Mi, Je, ll. with) a possessor: [[r:HEB.6.17|Heb 6:17 11:7]] (Cremer, 359 f.).† (AS)

G2819.root: probably from [[w:G2806]] (through the idea of using bits of wood, etc., for the purpose

senses: that which is obtained by casting: [[r:ACT.1.17|Act 1:17 8:21]]; of a part in the Kingdom of God (cf. Wis 55), [[r:ACT.26.18|Act 26:18]], [[r:COL.1.12|Col 1:12]]; pl. of the "cure" of a presbyter, [[r:1PE.5.3|1Pe 5:3]] (see ICC, in l).† (AS)

G2820.strongs: to allot, i.e. (figuratively) to assign (a privilege)
senses: to assign by lot, assign a portion: pass., ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν, [[r:EPH.1.11|Eph 1:11]] (on the various interpretations, see ICC; AR; Ellic., in l).† (AS)

G2822.strongs: invited, i.e. appointed, or (specially), a saint
senses: (καλέω), called, invited (as to a banquet, Æsch., [[r:1SA.1.41|1Sa 1:41]], [[r:3MA.5.14|3Ma 5:14]]); in NT, always of the Divine call;

to salvation: [[r:ROM.8.28|Rom 8:28]], [[r:1CO.1.24|1Co 1:24]], Ju 1; κ. καὶ ἐκλεκτοὶ κ. πιστοί, [[r:REV.17.14|Rev 17:14]]; in gosp. (not in pl., see: καλέω) disting. fr.ἐκλεκτός, [[r:MAT.20.16|Mat 20:16]] (WH, txt., R, omit), [[r:MAT.22.14|Mat 22:14]]; κ. Ἰησοῦ Χρ., [[r:ROM.1.6|Rom 1:6]]; κ. ἅγιοι, saints by calling, [[r:ROM.1.7|Rom 1:7]], [[r:1CO.1.2|1Co 1:2]].† (AS)

G2823.strongs: an earthen pot used for baking in
senses: (Att.., κρίβ-, but κλ- in Ion., Hdt., ii, 92),
in cl., a clibanus, cribanus, an earthen vessel for baking bread.
In LXX and NT, a furnace (cf. MM, Exp., xv), an oven: [[r:MAT.6.30|Mat 6:30]], [[r:LUK.12.28|Luk 12:28]].† (AS)

G2824.strongs: a slope, i.e. (specially) a "clime" or tract of country
senses: an inclination, slope, esp. the slope from the equator to the pole (Arist).

G2825.strongs: a couch (for sleep, sickness, sitting or eating)

G2826.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of [[w:G2825]]

G2827.strongs: to slant or slope, i.e. incline or recline (literally or figuratively)
G2827.kjv: bow (down), be far spent, lay, turn to flight, wear away
senses: to make to bend, to bow: τ. κεφαλήν (of one dying), [[r:JHN.19.30|Jhn 19:30]]; τ. πρόσωτον (of terrified persons), [[r:LUK.24.5|Luk 24:5.]]
to make to lean, to rest: τ. κεφαλήν (in sleep), [[r:MAT.8.20|Mat 8:20]], [[r:LUK.9.58|Luk 9:58]].
As in Hom., of soldiers, to turn (to flight), παρεμβολάς, [[r:HEB.11.34|Heb 11:34.]]
In late Gk. (as mid, in cl.), to decline: intrans., ἡ ἡμέρα, [[r:LUK.9.12|Luk 9:12 24:29]].† (AS)

G2828.strongs: properly, reclination, i.e. (concretely and specially), a party at a meal

senses: (κλύζω, of the sea, to wash over), a billow, surge: [[r:LUK.8.24|Luk 8:24]], [[r:JAS.1.6|Jas 1:6]].† SYN.: κῦμα, a wave (AS)
κλυδωνίζομαι (κλύδων), to be tossed by waves; metaphorically, to be tossed like waves (cf. FlJ, Ant., ix, 11, 3): [[r:EPH.4.14|Eph 4:14.]]† (AS)

G2832.forms: Κλωπᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram.; on the original, see Lft., Gal., 267 f.)

G2833.strongs: to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to tickle

senses: Cnidus, a city (and peninsula) on S.W. coast of Asia Minor: [[r:ACT.27.7|Act 27:7.]]† (AS)

G2835.forms: κοδράντης, -ου, ὁ (Lat. quadrans, the fourth part of an as)
G2835.strongs: a quadrans, i.e. the fourth part of an as

senses: Metaphorical (as Heb. בֶּטֶן, cf. [[r:JOB.15.35|Job 15:35]], [[r:PRO.20.27|Pro 20:27]], [[r:SIR.19.12|Sir 19:12]]), of the heart: [[r:JHN.7.38|Jhn 7:38.]]† (AS)

G2837.strongs: to put to sleep, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to slumber; figuratively, to decease
G2837.kjv: (be a-, fall a-, fall on) sleep, be dead

G2839.strongs: common, i.e. (literally) shared by all or several, or (ceremonially) profane
senses: common (general; = Lat. communis): [[r:ACT.2.44|Act 2:44 4:32]]; κ. πίστις, [[r:TIT.1.4|Tit 1:4]]; σωτηρία, Ju 3

In LXX, l.with, and NT (as κοινός, 2), to make ceremonially unclean, to profane (= cl., βεληλόω): [[r:MAT.15.11|Mat 15:11, 18 15:20]], [[r:MRK.7.15|Mrk 7:15, 18 7:20, 23]], [[r:ACT.21.28|Act 21:28]]; pass., [[r:HEB.9.13|Heb 9:13.]]

G2841.strongs: to share with others (objectively or subjectively)
senses: to have a share of, go shares in (something) with (some one), take part in: with genitive of thing(s) (as usually in cl., so Pr, l.with), [[r:HEB.2.14|Heb 2:14]]; with dative of thing(s), [[r:ROM.12.13|Rom 12:13 15:27]], [[r:1TI.5.22|1Ti 5:22]], [[r:1PE.4.13|1Pe 4:13]], 2Jn 11; with dative of person(s), before εἰς, [[r:PHP.4.15|Php 4:15]]; ἐν, [[r:GAL.6.6|Gal 6:6]] (cf. συν-κοινωνέω).† (AS)

G2842.strongs: partnership, i.e. (literally) participation, or (social) intercourse, or (pecuniary) benefaction
senses: fellowship, communion: [[r:ACT.2.42|Act 2:42]], [[r:2CO.6.14|2Co 6:14]], [[r:PHP.1.5|Php 1:5]]; τ. υἱοῦ, [[r:1CO.1.9|1Co 1:9]]; τ. αἵματος, σώματος Χρ., [[r:1CO.10.10|1Co 10:10]]: παθημάτων αὐτσῦ, [[r:PHP.3.10|Php 3:10]]; τ. πνεύματος, [[r:2CO.13.13|2Co 13:13]], [[r:PHP.2.1|Php 2:1]]; δεξιὰς κοινωνίας, [[r:GAL.2.9|Gal 2:9]]; τ. πίστεώς σου, Phm 6; before μετὰ: τ. πατρός, [[r:1JN.1.3|1Jn 1:3]] [[r:JHN.1.6|Jn 1:6]]; ἡμῶν, ἀλλήλων, [[r:1JN.1.3|1Jn 1:3]] [[r:JHN.1.7|Jn 1:7]].
contribution (as outcome of fellowship): [[r:ROM.15.26|Rom 15:26]], [[r:2CO.8.4|2Co 8:4 9:13]], [[r:HEB.13.6|Heb 13:6]] (cf. Art. Communion, DB, i, 460 ff.; MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)
ready to com­municate or impart (R, mg., ready to sympathize, see Field, Notes, 213 f.): [[r:1TI.6.18|1Ti 6:18.]]† (AS)

a partner, associate, companion: [[r:2CO.8.23|2Co 8:23]], Phm 17; with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.5.10|Luk 5:10]]; with genitive of person(s), [[r:HEB.10.33|Heb 10:33]]; id. before ἐν, [[r:MAT.23.30|Mat 23:30]];
a partaker, sharer: with genitive of thing(s), [[r:1CO.10.18|1Co 10:18 10:20]], [[r:2CO.1.7|2Co 1:7]], [[r:1PE.5.1|1Pe 5:1]], [[r:2PE.1.4|2Pe 1:4]] (see Deiss., BS, 368 n2).† (AS)

G2845.strongs: a couch; by extension, cohabitation; by implication, the male sperm
senses: a bed: [[r:LUK.11.7|Luk 11:7]]; esp. the marriage-bed: κ. ἀμίαντος, [[r:HEB.13.4|Heb 13:4]]; κ. ἔχειν, of a woman conceiving, [[r:ROM.9.10|Rom 9:10]] (cf. peculiar phrases in LXX, [[r:LEV.15.18|Lev 15:18]], al.); of illicit intercourse, pl., [[r:ROM.13.13|Rom 13:13.]]† (AS)
(κοίτη = Att.., δωμότιον, see Kennedy, Sources, 40), a bed-chamber; ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ κ., a chamberlain: [[r:ACT.12.20|Act 12:20.]]† (AS)

senses: (κόκκος, as used of the "berry" of the ilex coccifera, see DB, iv, 416), scarlet: [[r:MAT.27.28|Mat 27:28]], [[r:HEB.9.19|Heb 9:19]], [[r:REV.17.3|Rev 17:3]]; neut., without substantive, of clothing, [[r:REV.17.4|Rev 17:4 18:12, 16]],† (AS)

G2849.strongs: properly, to curtail, i.e. (figuratively) to chastise (or reserve for infliction)
senses: to chastise, correct, punish: pass., [[r:2PE.2.9|2Pe 2:9]]; mid., cause to be punished ([[r:3MA.7.3|3Ma 7:3]]): [[r:ACT.4.21|Act 4:21]].† (AS)

G2850.root: from a derivative of κόλαξ (a fawner)

Arist. distinguishes between κ. as that which, being disciplinary, has reference to the sufferer, and τ. as that which, being penal, has reference to the satisfaction of him who inflicts (see Thayer, see word κ., and cf. Tr., Syn., § vii). But in late Gk. especially, the distinction is not always maintained (see reff. in Thayer) (AS)

G2852.root: from a derivative of the base of [[w:G2849]]
senses: (κόλαφος = Att.., κόνδυλοι, the knuckles, the closed fist) to strike with the fist, to buffet: [[r:MAT.26.67|Mat 26:67]], [[r:MRK.14.65|Mrk 14:65]], [[r:2CO.12.7|2Co 12:7]]; pass., [[r:1CO.4.11|1Co 4:11]], [[r:1PE.2.20|1Pe 2:20]].† (AS)

G2853.strongs: to glue, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to stick (figuratively)
senses: Generally, to unite, to join firmly. Pass., to cleave to, join (oneself to): with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.19.5|Mat 19:5]](LXX), [[r:LUK.10.11|Luk 10:11 15:15]], [[r:ACT.5.13|Act 5:13]] (but see Field, Notes, 118) [[r:ACT.9.26|Act 9:26 10:28]] (see Field, l.with) [[r:ACT.17.34|Act 17:34]]; τ. πόρνῃ, [[r:1CO.6.16|1Co 6:16]]; τ. Κυρίῳ, [[r:1CO.6.17|1Co 6:17]]; with dative of thing(s), ἅρματι, [[r:ACT.8.29|Act 8:29]]; τ. ἀγαθῴ, [[r:ROM.12.9|Rom 12:9]]; of sins joining together, ἄχρι τ. οὐρανοῦ, [[r:REV.18.5|Rev 18:5]], of dust, [[r:LUK.10.11|Luk 10:11]] (cf. τροσ-κολλάω).† (AS)

G2854.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of κολλύρα (a cake
G2854.strongs: prob akin to the base of); properly, a poultice (as made of or in the form of crackers), i.e. (by analogy) a plaster
senses: (TTr., κολλύ-, the more usual form), -ου, τό (dimin. of κολλύρα = κόλλιξ, a coarse bread roll),
a small bread roll (LXX, ll. with).
(Usually in pl., LS, see word) an eye salve shaped like a roll: [[r:REV.3.18|Rev 3:18.]]† (AS)

G2855.root: from a presumed derivative of κόλλυβος (a small coin
senses: (κόλλυβος, a small coin, a rate of exchange), a money-changer: [[r:MAT.21.12|Mat 21:12]], [[r:MRK.11.15|Mrk 11:15]], [[r:JHN.2.15|Jhn 2:15]] (of. κερματιοτής).† (AS)

G2856.root: from a derivative of the base of [[w:G2849]]
senses: (κολοβός, docked), to cut off, amputate (LXX), hence, to curtail, shorten: [[r:MAT.24.22|Mat 24:22]], [[r:MRK.13.20|Mrk 13:20]].† (AS)

G2857.strongs: Colossæ, a place in Asia Minor
senses: (so in cl.; -ασσαί, Rec., LTr.), -ῶν, αἰ Colossæ, a city on the Lycus in Phrygia: [[r:COL.1.2|Col 1:2.]]† (AS)

G2859.strongs: the bosom; by analogy, a bay
senses: prop., the bosom: [[r:JHN.13.23|Jhn 13:23]]; fig., of close association, ἐν (εἰς τὸν) τοῖς κ. Ἀβραάμ, [[r:LUK.16.22|Luk 16:22-23]] (cf. 4Ma.13:16); ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κ. τ. πατρός, [[r:JHN.1.18|Jhn 1:18]]
The bosom or fold of a loose garment falling over a girdle, used as a pocket, hence figuratively, εἰς τὸν κ. [[r:ISA.65.6|Isa 65:6]], [[r:JER.32.18|Jer 32:18]]: [[r:LUK.6.38|Luk 6:38]]
A bosom-like hollow, as a bay or gulf: [[r:ACT.27.39|Act 27:39.]]† (AS)
to dive, plunge into the sea: [[r:ACT.27.43|Act 27:43]] (cf. ἐκ-κολνμβάω).† (AS)

G2861.strongs: a diving-place, i.e. pond for bathing (or swimming)

senses: κολωνία (Rec. -ώνια), -ας, ἡ (Lat. colonic), a colony: [[r:ACT.16.12|Act 16:12]] (see Lft., Phi., 50 f.).† (AS)

G2864.strongs: the hair of the head (locks, as ornamental, and thus differing from; which properly denotes merely the scalp)

G2865.root: from a primary κομέω (to tend, i.e. take care of)
G2865.strongs: properly, to provide for, i.e. (by implication) to carry off (as if from harm; genitive case obtain)
senses: to bear or carry: [[r:LUK.7.37|Luk 7:37.]] Mid., to bear for oneself, hence,

to receive back, recover (in cl. so also act.): [[r:MAT.25.27|Mat 25:27]], [[r:HEB.11.19|Heb 11:19]]; metaphorically, of requital, [[r:2CO.5.10|2Co 5:10]], [[r:COL.3.25|Col 3:25]]; παρὰ Κυρίου, [[r:EPH.6.8|Eph 6:8]] (cf. ἐκ-, συν-κομίζω).† (AS)

G2866.root: neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of 2865 (meaning, properly, well dressed, i.e. nice)
senses: κομψός, -ή, -όν (κομέω, to take care of), well-dressed, elegant, fine; compar. neut., κομψότερον ἔχειν (cf. κόμψως ἔχειν, Epict., and colloq. Eng., "to be doing finely"): [[r:JHN.4.52|Jhn 4:52.]]† (AS)
(κονία, dust, lime), to plaster or whiten over: of tombs, [[r:MAT.23.27|Mat 23:27]]; figuratively, of a hypocrite, [[r:ACT.23.3|Act 23:3.]]† (AS)

G2868.root: from the base of [[w:G2867]] and ornumi (to "rouse")
senses: (κόνις or κονία, dust, ὄρνυμι, to stir up), in cl., dust stirred up ([[r:EXO.9.9|Exo 9:9]], [[r:ISA.5.24|Isa 5:24]]); in NT, simply dust: [[r:MAT.10.14|Mat 10:14]], [[r:LUK.9.5|Luk 9:5 10:11]], [[r:ACT.13.51|Act 13:51 22:23]].† (AS)
(κόπος), to grow weary; of the wind (Hdt., Jh., l.with), to abate, cease raging: [[r:MAT.14.32|Mat 14:32]], [[r:MRK.4.39|Mrk 4:39 6:51]].† (AS)
(κόπτω, mid.), = cl. κομμός, a beating of the head and breast, lamentation: before ἐπί with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.8.2|Act 8:2.]]† (AS)
in cl., a stroke, a pounding (as in a mortar).

G2872.strongs: to feel fatigue; by implication, to work hard
senses: Hence, in LXX and NT, to work with effort, to toil: absol., [[r:MAT.6.23|Mat 6:23]], [[r:LUK.5.5|Luk 5:5 12:27]], [[r:JHN.4.38|Jhn 4:38]], [[r:ACT.20.35|Act 20:35]], [[r:1CO.4.12|1Co 4:12]], [[r:EPH.4.28|Eph 4:28]], [[r:2TI.2.5|2Ti 2:5]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:JHN.4.38|Jhn 4:38]]; frequently in Paul. Epp., of ministerial labour: [[r:1CO.15.10|1Co 15:10 16:16]]; before ἐν, [[r:ROM.16.12|Rom 16:12]], [[r:1TH.5.12|1Th 5:12]] (see M, Th., in l), [[r:1TI.5.17|1Ti 5:17]]; εἰς, [[r:ROM.16.6|Rom 16:6]], [[r:GAL.4.11|Gal 4:11]], [[r:PHP.2.16|Php 2:16]], [[r:COL.1.29|Col 1:29]], [[r:1TI.4.10|1Ti 4:10]].† (AS)

G2873.strongs: a cut, i.e. (by analogy) toil (as reducing the strength), literally or figuratively; by implication, pains
senses: laborious toil, trouble: [[r:JHN.4.38|Jhn 4:38]], [[r:1CO.3.8|1Co 3:8 15:58]], [[r:1TH.3.5|1Th 3:5]]; κ. τ. ἀγάπης, [[r:1TH.1.3|1Th 1:3]]; ἔργα καὶ κ., [[r:REV.2.2|Rev 2:2]]; κ. καὶ μόχθος, [[r:2CO.11.27|2Co 11:27]], [[r:1TH.2.9|1Th 2:9]], [[r:2TH.3.8|2Th 3:8]]; pl., ἐν κ., [[r:2CO.6.5|2Co 6:5 10:15 11:23]]; ἐκ τ. κ., [[r:REV.14.13|Rev 14:13]]; κόπονς (-ον) παρέχειν (in cl. more frequently π. πράγματα, πονον), with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.26.10|Mat 26:10]], [[r:MRK.14.6|Mrk 14:6]], [[r:LUK.11.7|Luk 11:7 18:5]], [[r:GAL.6.17|Gal 6:17]].† SYN.: μόλθος, labour; πόνος (which see), toil, painful effort; in cl., "π. gives prominence to the effort (work as requiring force), κ. to the fatigue, μ. (chiefly poetic) to the hardship" (Thayer, see word κ.) (AS)
a dung hill ([[r:1KI.2.8|1Ki 2:8]], [[r:PSA.113.7|Psa 113:7]] al.): [[r:LUK.14.35|Luk 14:35]].† κόπριον, -ου, τό, = κόπρος, dung: pl., [[r:LUK.13.8|Luk 13:8]] (WH, mg., κόφινον κοπρίων).† (AS)

G2875.strongs: to "chop"; specially, to beat the breast in grief
senses: to cut off: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, [[r:MAT.21.8|Mat 21:8]]; ἐκ, [[r:MRK.11.8|Mrk 11:8.]] Mid., to beat one's breast with grief, to mourn, bewail: [[r:MAT.11.17|Mat 11:17 24:30]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.8.52|Luk 8:52 23:27]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:REV.1.7|Rev 1:7 18:9]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐν-, κατα-, προ-, προσ-κόπτω).† SYN.: θρηνέω, q.v (AS)

G2877.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of κόρη (a maiden)
senses: (dimin. of κόρη), a colloquial word which survives in MGr. (Kennedy, Sourcs, e154), girl, maiden: [[r:MAT.9.24|Mat 9:24-25 14:11]], [[r:MRK.5.41|Mrk 5:41-42 6:22, 28]].† (AS)

G2878.root: of Hebrew and Chaldee origin respectively ([[w:H7133]])
G2878.strongs: a votive offering and the offering; a consecrated present (to the Temple fund); by extension (the latter term) the Treasury itself, i.e. the room where the contribution boxes stood
senses: κορβάν (Rec., T, -βᾶν), indecl. (Heb. קׇרְבָּן), an offering, a gift offered to God: [[r:MRK.7.11|Mrk 7:11]] (cf. κορβανᾶς).† (AS)

G2880.strongs: to cram, i.e. glut or sate
senses: (κόρος, surfeit), to satisfy: pass., τροφῆς, [[r:ACT.27.38|Act 27:38]]; metaphorically, of spiritual things, [[r:1CO.4.8|1Co 4:8.]]† (AS)

G2881.strongs: a Corinthian, i.e. inhabitant of Corinth
senses: κορίνθιος, -α, -ον Corinthian; as subst., ὁ Κ., a Corinthian: [[r:ACT.18.8|Act 18:8 27:1-44]] (WH, txt., R, omit), [[r:2CO.6.11|2Co 6:11]]; 1Co, 2Co, tit.† (AS)

G2884.strongs: a cor, i.e. a specific measure
senses: (Heb. כֹּר), a cor, a Hebrew measure (AV, RV, measure): [[r:LUK.16.7|Luk 16:7.]]† (AS)

G2885.strongs: to put in proper order, i.e. decorate (literally or figuratively); specially, to snuff (a wick)
senses: to order, arrange, prepare (in Hom. esp. of marshalling armies): [[r:MAT.25.7|Mat 25:7]] (cf. [[r:SIR.50.9|Sir 50:9]], al.).

to adorn, furnish: οἶκον, pass., [[r:MAT.12.44|Mat 12:44]], [[r:LUK.11.25|Luk 11:25]]; μνημεῖα, [[r:MAT.23.29|Mat 23:29]]; τὸ ἱερόν, pass., [[r:LUK.21.5|Luk 21:5]]; θεμέλιοι, [[r:REV.21.19|Rev 21:19]]; νύμφην, pass., [[r:REV.21.2|Rev 21:2]]; ἐαυτάς, before ἐν, [[r:1TI.2.9|1Ti 2:9.]] Metaphorical, with accusative of person(s), [[r:1PE.3.5|1Pe 3:5]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:TIT.2.10|Tit 2:10.]]† (AS)
pertaining to the world or universe.

G2888.strongs: a world-ruler, an epithet of Satan
senses: in Orphic hymns, al. (see AR, Eph., l.with), a ruler of the whole world (and so in Rabbinic writings: קוֺזמוֺקְרָטוֺר).
a ruler of this world (in contrast to παντο κράτωρ): οἱ κ. τ. σκότους τούτου, the rulers of this dark world, [[r:EPH.6.12|Eph 6:12.]]† (AS)

G2889.strongs: orderly arrangement, i.e. decoration; by implication, the world (in a wide or narrow sense, including its inhabitants, literally or figuratively (morally))
senses: Later, the world or universe, as an ordered system (Plat., al.): [[r:ACT.17.24|Act 17:24]], [[r:ROM.4.13|Rom 4:13]], [[r:1CO.3.22|1Co 3:22]], [[r:PHP.2.15|Php 2:15]], [[r:HEB.4.3|Heb 4:3]], al.

In late writers only, the world, i.e. the earth (= ἡ οἰκουμένη, cf. [[r:MAT.4.8|Mat 4:8]] with [[r:LUK.4.5|Luk 4:5]]): [[r:MAT.4.8|Mat 4:8]], Mrk.16:, [[r:COL.2.20|Col 2:20]], [[r:1TI.6.7|1Ti 6:7]], al.; hence by meton.,

of worldly affairs or possessions: [[r:MAT.16.26|Mat 16:26]], [[r:MRK.8.36|Mrk 8:36]], [[r:LUK.9.25|Luk 9:25]], [[r:1CO.7.31|1Co 7:31]], [[r:1JN.2.16|1Jn 2:16]], al.; (with) in ethical sense, of the ungodly: [[r:JHN.7.7|Jhn 7:7 14:17, 27]] [[r:1CO.1.21|1Co 1:21]], [[r:JAS.1.27|Jas 1:27]], [[r:1JN.4.4|1Jn 4:4]], al.;

metaphorically: ὁ κ. τῆς ἀδικίας, [[r:JAS.3.6|Jas 3:6.]] SYN.: αἰών, which see (cf. also Dalman, Words, 162ff.; Tr., Syn., §lix; Westc., additional note on [[r:JHN.1.10|Jhn 1:10]]; DB, iv, 938ff.). (AS)
κούμ (Tr., txt., κοῦμ, Rec. κοῦμι) (Heb. imperat. masc., used as an interjection, קוּם), koum (arise): [[r:MRK.5.41|Mrk 5:41.]]† (AS)
a basket, probably of wicker-work, such as were carried by Jews for food: [[r:MAT.14.20|Mat 14:20 16:9]], [[r:MRK.6.43|Mrk 6:43 8:19 9:17 13:8]], [[r:JHN.6.13|Jhn 6:13]] (cf. σφυρίς).† (AS)

κράβαττος (Rec. κράββατος), ου, ὁ (a Macedonian word, = Lat. grabatus, cl. σκίμπους), a camp bed, pallet: [[r:MRK.2.4|Mrk 2:4, 9 2:11-12 6:55]], [[r:JHN.5.8|Jhn 5:8-11]], [[r:ACT.5.15|Act 5:15 9:33]] (see Swete, Mk., 24, and cf. κλίνη).† (AS)

G2896.strongs: properly, to "croak" (as a raven) or scream, i.e. (genitive case) to call aloud (shriek, exclaim, intreat)
senses: prop. onomatop., of the raven, to croak, hence generally, of inartic. cries, to scream, cry out (Æsch., al.): [[r:MRK.5.5|Mrk 5:5 9:26 15:39]] (Rec., R, mg.), [[r:LUK.9.39|Luk 9:39]], al.; of crying for vengeance (cf. [[r:GEN.4.10|Gen 4:10]]), [[r:JAS.5.4|Jas 5:4]].

to cry, call out with a loud voice: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.19.32|Act 19:32]]; before orat. dir., [[r:MRK.10.48|Mrk 10:48]], [[r:LUK.18.39|Luk 18:39]], al.; (ἐν) φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, [[r:MRK.5.7|Mrk 5:7]], [[r:REV.14.15|Rev 14:15]], al.; λέγων, [[r:MAT.8.29|Mat 8:29]], al.; of public teaching, [[r:JHN.1.15|Jhn 1:15]], [[r:ROM.9.27|Rom 9:27]], al.; of importunate prayer (cf. [[r:JOB.35.12|Job 35:12]], [[r:PSA.3.5|Psa 3:5]], al.), [[r:ROM.8.15|Rom 8:15]], [[r:GAL.4.6|Gal 4:6]]; pf. with Pres. sense (vernac.; M, Pr., 147), [[r:JHN.1.15|Jhn 1:15]] SYN.: see: βοάω (AS)

G2897.strongs: properly, a headache (as a seizure of pain) from drunkenness, i.e. (by implication) a debauch (by analogy, a glut)
senses: (κρεπάλη, WH), -ης, ἡ (cf. κραιπαλάω for שִׁכּוֹר, [[r:ISA.24.20|Isa 24:20 29:9]]) drunken nausea (EV, surfeiting): [[r:LUK.21.34|Luk 21:34.]]† SYN.: κῶμος, revelling; μέθη, drunkeness; οἰνοφλυγία, a debauch; πότος, a drinking bout (see Tr., Syn., § lxi). (AS)

G2898.root: diminutive of a derivative of the base of [[w:G2768]]

G2899.strongs: a margin, i.e. (specially), a fringe or tassel
senses: In LXX (see supr.) and NT, a tassel or corner: [[r:MAT.9.20|Mat 9:20 14:36 23:5]], [[r:MRK.6.56|Mrk 6:56]], [[r:LUK.8.44|Luk 8:44]].† (AS)
a Colossian: pl., Col., tit. (and subscr., Rec., Tr.).† (AS)
